body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> G-Technology by Hitachi (www.g-technology.com) announced that it is incorporating Hitachi's 2TB, 7,200 RPM, 32MB cache buffer hard drives across its entire 3.5-inch product line during Digital Experience at CES 2010.

Now with capacities ranging from 2TB to 32TB, G-Tech's new upgraded single-drive and ultra-fast, low-cost RAID systems include the G-DRIVE, G-SAFE, G-RAID, G-SPEED eS, G-SPEED eS Pro, G-SPEED eS PRO XL, and G-SPEED FC XL.

With the addition of these new drives, G-Tech is now the only external storage provider in the world with a complete line of 2TB, 7,200 RPM drive-based, external storage solutions specifically designed for the Mac and AV markets.
